nodes.summary: JSON game-data file defining the full perk dataset (name, description, tags) used as the master perk registry for Voxel Blade build simulation.

nodes.name: perks.json
nodes.summary: Perk dataset (~350 entries). Each object has name (unique perk id), description (free-text mechanics) and tags (category strings: Defensive/Offensive, source/equip, effect types like Damage Boost, Buff, Debuff, Damage Reduction, Cooldown Reduction, etc.). Perk amounts live in referencing data (blades.json), looked up by name via getPerk() in src/lib/engine/data/character.ts.
